headline: SpaceX's Starship reaches Earth orbit for the first time on 14th test flight

supports: SpaceX's Starship Flight 14 launched from Starbase in Boca Chica, Texas on September 28, 2026 and reached Earth orbit for the first time in the vehicle's test-flight history.
The flight deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites into orbit.
One Raptor 3 engine aboard the Starship upper stage shut down unexpectedly during ascent and was relit to complete orbital insertion.

caption:
🇺🇸 SpaceX's Starship rocket reached Earth orbit for the first time on Sept. 28, on its 14th test flight, launching from Starbase in Boca Chica, Texas. The mission deployed 26 next-generation Starlink V3 satellites; one Raptor 3 engine on the upper stage shut down unexpectedly during ascent but the vehicle recovered in time to complete orbital insertion.

🇪🇸 El cohete Starship de SpaceX alcanzó por primera vez la órbita terrestre el 28 de septiembre, en su decimocuarto vuelo de prueba, despegando desde Starbase en Boca Chica, Texas. La misión desplegó 26 satélites Starlink V3 de nueva generación; un motor Raptor 3 de la etapa superior se apagó inesperadamente durante el ascenso, pero la nave se recuperó a tiempo para completar la inserción orbital.

Sources: UPI / Space.com — Sept. 28, 2026.
